prompt: Name a letter of the Greek alphabet.
note: Scoring answers are the first fifteen letters in sequence (Alpha through Omicron), not the fifteen most-recognisable — see content/games/004/01-language.json's history if that ever needs revisiting. Extras are the remaining nine (Pi through Omega), so all twenty-four letters are accounted for either way.

answers.name: Alpha
answers.fact: First letter, and the source of the word alphabet - alpha plus beta.

answers.name: Beta
answers.fact: Second letter. Gave its name to software that is not finished yet.

answers.name: Gamma
answers.fact: Third letter. Lends its name to the most energetic light in the spectrum.

answers.name: Delta
answers.fact: Fourth letter. Its triangular capital gave river deltas their name.

answers.name: Theta
answers.fact: Eighth letter. Once marked a death sentence on Athenian ballots, for thanatos.

answers.name: Omicron
answers.fact: Fifteenth letter, meaning little o. Known to most people only since 2021.

answers.name: Epsilon
answers.fact: Fifth letter. Means simply e - the short e, as opposed to eta.

answers.name: Zeta
answers.fact: Sixth letter, and the name of a famous unsolved problem in mathematics.

answers.name: Kappa
answers.fact: Tenth letter, and also a sarcasm emote on Twitch, based on a photo of a former site employee.

answers.name: Lambda
answers.fact: Eleventh letter. The Spartan shield emblem, for Lacedaemon.

answers.name: Iota
answers.fact: Ninth letter, and the smallest - hence not one iota.

answers.name: Eta
answers.fact: Seventh letter, and the shape the capital lent to the Latin H.

answers.name: Mu
answers.fact: Twelfth letter, and the prefix micro-.

answers.name: Nu
answers.fact: Thirteenth letter, and the symbol physicists use for frequency in E = hν.

answers.name: Xi
answers.fact: Fourteenth letter, and among the hardest to pronounce in English.

extras.name: Pi
extras.fact: Sixteenth letter. Chosen for the circle constant in 1706, from the Greek for perimeter.

extras.name: Rho
extras.fact: Seventeenth letter, used for density in physics.

extras.name: Sigma
extras.fact: Eighteenth letter. The capital means sum in mathematics; the lowercase means standard deviation.

extras.name: Tau
extras.fact: Nineteenth letter, and a rival to pi among mathematicians.

extras.name: Upsilon
extras.fact: Twentieth letter, and the ancestor of both U and Y in the Latin alphabet.

extras.name: Phi
extras.fact: Twenty-first letter. Used for the golden ratio, roughly 1.618.

extras.name: Chi
extras.fact: Twenty-second letter, the X in Xmas.

extras.name: Psi
extras.fact: Twenty-third letter, and the symbol for psychology.

extras.name: Omega
extras.fact: The last letter, which is why the end of anything is the omega.
